name: Vili’s Health Bar
notes: Own site (Weebly) links a 6-page priced PDF menu ('Vili's Health Bar Menu (5)') pulled directly with curl and read via pdftotext -layout - no browser needed. Full section coverage: Basics (drip/espresso/latte coffees), Bullet Coffee (14 variants), Smoothies (10), Superfood Smoothie Bowls (5), Organic Loose Leaf Tea (flat $3.50, no per-flavor price so tea flavors omitted). Note: the PDF and the site's own footer both list the address as 4861 Newport Avenue, Ocean Beach, but the work-list address is 1780 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. WebSearch (Yelp, Waze, DoorDash, TripTap) confirms 1780 Sunset Cliffs Blvd as the current, correct address for this exact business name/phone-area; the website's address appears stale. Same unique brand (organic bullet coffee + vegan superfood desserts in Ocean Beach), so treated as the same restaurant despite the site's outdated address line.

name: Tacos El Gallo
notes: No own website (Instagram only). Matched by exact address (569 N 2nd St, El Cajon) via search. Full schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD pulled via curl, 37 distinct dishes across 3 sections (Most Ordered/Tacos El Gallo/Drinks - the first two overlap almost entirely so treated as one taco-shop menu). Division test against 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3 found no dominant clean multiplier among the 15 distinct prices, so no clear delivery-markup signature. Could not reach a working Uber Eats page to cross-check within time budget (redirect issue). Recorded medium per the ladder (single delivery source, passes markup test).

name: Sro Lounge
notes: No website, no DoorDash/Grubhub/UberEats listing. Every search result besides Yelp (barred) is a directory-farm/fabricated-listing page (weeblyte.com, placejoys.com, foodjoyy.com, restaurants-info.com) with no genuine per-item prices - restaurantguru.com's own menu page loaded but contained zero prices. This is a gay bar/lounge with informal food (a Friday chicken buffet mentioned in reviews) and no evidence anywhere of a published per-item priced menu. Recorded not_found rather than blocked since no priced source appears to exist at all, not merely one that needs a browser.

name: Poncho's Mexican & Sea Food
notes: Own site (ponchosmexicanfoodca.com) has no public menu page - ordering is only through a native app (Apple/Google Play, smarterswipe.com backend), which is not readable without a browser/app. Matched by exact name and address (1279 E Main St, El Cajon) to a DoorDash listing. Full schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD pulled via curl, 91 dishes across 13 sections (Most Ordered, Extra/add-ons, Seafood Plates, Seafood Cocktails, Protein Bowls, Kids Plates, Drinks, Sides, Quesadillas, Tortas, Tostadas, Soups, Combination Plates) - full section coverage for a Mexican & seafood menu including seafood plates/cocktails matching the restaurant's name. Division test found no dominant clean multiplier (best case 10/41 distinct prices near-divide by 1.25, not a strong signal); prices carry unusual non-round, non-.99 cents throughout which is unusual but not diagnostic of a specific known markup pattern - recorded at medium (tier-3 delivery source, ladder default) with this caveat noted. NOTE: be careful not to confuse this with the separate/different-named 'Pancho's Mexican Restaurant' (panchosatelcajon.com) or the differently-branded 'Ponchos Taco Shop' DoorDash listing at a similar area - this entry is specifically 'Ponchos Mexican and Seafood - EL CAJON on Main St' at the exact matching address.
